title: Architecture Case Studies
description: Interactive lecture: two software architecture case studies (Muscar.auto telemetry and the Dunderly HR system) with simulators, calculators and an API sandbox.
footerHtml: Case studies adapted from Memi Lavi, Software Architecture Case Studies (memilavi.com)
helpNote: Every simulator and calculator runs in your browser. Numbers marked as teaching models (capacities, scores, the queueing chart) are illustrative; the figures from the case studies (messages per second, GB, prices, API paths) come from the case studies. Case studies adapted from Memi Lavi, Software Architecture Case Studies (www.memilavi.com).
